analysis: The program reads /input/data.csv, filters ethics-focused debates, validates and coerces relevant fields, reports sample size and missingness, computes Pearson correlations with percentage increase in utilitarianism, compares critical-event groups, summarizes moderator stances, and estimates adjusted relationships using a pure-Python least-squares regression with controls for moderator stance, audience interest, average duration, number of sessions, and critical events. It also reports a simple negative-control correlation between argument intensity and external temperature when available. Outputs are descriptive associations only.
